correctness.rationale: The real P1 projector is represented by a positive-definite Gram matrix. Its exact inverse rows give kernels with alternating signs on every unit edge; signed affine integrals yield all three nodal norms. Strict rational differences force leaf norming; convexity of edge-interior evaluation kernels rules out all interior norming locations. The coarse star norm follows analogously, and an explicit cubic polynomial with positive coefficients after d=4 proves the strict refinement reversal. An independent rational matrix-inversion/kernel checker succeeds for degrees 2..17, with symbolic all-degree identities.

value.rationale: Uniform midpoint mesh refinement is a canonical numerical-approximation operation. The exact infinity-norm amplification changes direction at a sharp topological degree threshold, in spite of identical edge lengths and refinement on every arm; norming evaluations are completely classified. This gives a natural exact stability baseline for branched networks and an explicit nonzero limiting improvement, not a routine substitution into the earlier coarse-star formula.
